description: This file defines a report parser class for POS details summary in an Odoo module, including methods for calculating totals, discounts, taxes, and formatting report data.

classes.name: pos_details_summary
classes.description: A report parser class for POS details summary, providing methods to compute totals, discounts, taxes, and report formatting.

methods.name: _get_sum_discount
methods.description: Calculates total discount value from objects.

methods.name: _get_payments
methods.description: Aggregates payment amounts, optionally ignoring gift payments.

methods.name: _total_of_the_day
methods.description: Calculates net total for the day after invoiced amount.

methods.name: _ellipsis
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length with ellipsis.

methods.name: _strip_name
methods.description: Truncates a name string to 50 characters.

methods.name: _get_tax_amount
methods.description: Calculates tax amounts for order lines.

methods.name: _get_sales_total
methods.description: Counts total number of sales lines.

methods.name: _get_period
methods.description: Returns the date period covered by the objects.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and updates local context with methods.
